text: あいてから　うける　じぶんへの　こうか　◎じめん　エスパー　△くさ　かくとう　どく　むし
note: ◎, △ and × are the standard Japanese rating marks used on forms, reviews and school work: ◎ (double circle) means excellent, △ means so-so and × means no good. Here they stand for super effective, not very effective and no effect.
claim: In Japan the symbols ◎, ○, △ and × are a conventional rating scale, with ◎ meaning excellent, △ meaning mediocre and × meaning bad or wrong.

check.quote: Japan employs a number of related symbols (◎ ○ △ ×) in a system that expresses degrees of affirmation.
